query:
UPDATE t_delivery_note
            SET status           = $2,
                submitted_at     = $3,
                picked_up_at     = $4,
                submitted_by     = $5,
                picked_up_by     = $6,
                driver_worker_id = $7,
                note             = $8,
                delivery_date    = $9,
                version          = $10,
                updated_at       = $11,
                updated_by       = $12
            WHERE id = $1 AND version = $13 AND deleted_at IS NULL
